item.title: Who helps educators make sense of children’s learning?
item.description: A lunchbox that will not open, a friend who is away or not knowing where to go can be a matter of concern to a child. Their questions can highlight the areas we should help them prepare for. Where will I put my bag? What if I can’t open my lunch? Who will I play with if my friend isn’t there?

item.title: Early childhood training gets five-year deal in $560M TAFE deal
item.description: Early childhood education has been named among the fields supported by a $560M Free TAFE agreement between the Australian and NSW governments to fund vocational training for five years from 2027. The deal gives a longer planning horizon but the number of early childhood training places has not been announced.
